sql.query: SELECT h.id,h.fromStageId,h.toStageId,h.transitionType,h.readinessResult,h.approvalComment,h.overrideReason,h.blockingTaskCount,h.onHoldTaskCount,h.missingResponseCount,h.transitionDate,fromStage.stageName fromStageName,toStage.stageName toStageName,u.displayName approvedByName FROM tbl_record_stage_history h INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=h.workflowId AND w.tenantId=h.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_workflow_stages fromStage ON fromStage.id=h.fromStageId AND fromStage.workflowId=h.workflowId AND fromStage.tenantId=h.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages toStage ON toStage.id=h.toStageId AND toStage.workflowId=h.workflowId AND toStage.tenantId=h.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=h.approvedByUserId WHERE h.workflowId=:recordId AND h.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY h.transitionDate DESC,h.id DESC
